name: Ozil Goal AI
tagline: Score Mesut Özil’s famous 2016 goal yourself, from one photo.
description: Ozil Goal AI recreates Mesut Özil’s viral 2016 Ludogorets goal with you on the ball. Upload one photo and get a 14-second vertical video with crowd noise: you chip the keeper, let two defenders slide past and finish into the empty net. Your face, hair and clothes; his moves. From $9.90. Not affiliated with Mesut Özil, Arsenal or UEFA.
